profile.name: Enzo Dinglasan
profile.summary:
I build full-stack web applications that connect clear, usable interfaces with the APIs, data, and cloud infrastructure behind them. My work spans SaaS, e-commerce, fintech, and logistics, using React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, and PostgreSQL.

Coming from a frontend background, I’ve grown into backend development, technical ownership, and leading small teams. I’m comfortable building from scratch or taking over an existing product—understanding how it works, making practical technical decisions, and carrying changes through to deployment.
profile.headline: I build and deliver full-stack web applications, from interface to APIs and cloud deployment.
